mapper.select: SELECT id FROM warehouse.suppliers WHERE registration_number = #{ico} AND is_active = TRUE
SELECT id FROM warehouse.suppliers WHERE registration_number = #{ico} AND is_active = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse.suppliers (name, registration_number, vat_id, street, city, postal_code, bank_account, iban, swift, email, phone) VALUES (#{name}, #{registrationNumber}, #{vatId}, #{street}, #{city}, #{postalCode}, #{bankAccount}, #{iban}, #{swift}, #{email}, #{phone})

INSERT INTO warehouse.goods_receipts (supplier_id, supplier_name_snapshot, invoice_number, order_number, original_order_number, issue_date, due_date, taxable_supply_date, subtotal, vat_amount, total_amount, currency, document_type, source_channel, draft_payload, status, reconciliation_ok, extraction_model, source_filename, source_pdf, created_by) VALUES (#{supplierId}, #{supplierNameSnapshot}, #{invoiceNumber}, #{orderNumber}, #{originalOrderNumber}, #{issueDate}, #{dueDate}, #{taxableSupplyDate}, #{subtotal}, #{vatAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{currency}, #{documentType, typeHandler=cz.palo.autoservis.config.mybatis.PgEnumTypeHandler$DocumentTypeHandler}, #{sourceChannel, typeHandler=cz.palo.autoservis.config.mybatis.PgEnumTypeHandler$ReceiptSourceHandler}, CAST(#{draftPayload} AS jsonb), #{status, typeHandler=cz.palo.autoservis.config.mybatis.PgEnumTypeHandler$ReceiptStatusHandler}, #{reconciliationOk}, #{extractionModel}, #{sourceFilename}, #{sourcePdf}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM warehouse.products WHERE sku = #{sku} AND is_active = TRUE
SELECT id FROM warehouse.products WHERE sku = #{sku} AND is_active = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse.products (sku, name, manufacturer_part_number, unit, default_vat_rate) VALUES (#{sku}, #{name}, #{manufacturerPartNumber}, #{unit}, #{defaultVatRate})

INSERT INTO warehouse.goods_receipt_items (goods_receipt_id, product_id, position, name_snapshot, quantity_received, quantity_remaining, unit_price_excl_vat, vat_rate, total_incl_vat) VALUES (#{goodsReceiptId}, #{productId}, #{position}, #{nameSnapshot}, #{quantityReceived}, #{quantityRemaining}, #{unitPriceExclVat}, #{vatRate}, #{totalInclVat})

INSERT INTO warehouse.receipt_delivery_note_refs (goods_receipt_id, delivery_note_number, matched_receipt_id, resolution) VALUES (#{goodsReceiptId}, #{number}, #{matchedReceiptId}, CAST(#{resolution} AS warehouse.dn_ref_resolution)) ON CONFLICT (goods_receipt_id, delivery_note_number) DO UPDATE SET matched_receipt_id = EXCLUDED.matched_receipt_id, resolution = EXCLUDED.resolution

INSERT INTO warehouse.stock_movements (product_id, batch_id, movement_type, quantity, order_id, order_item_id, return_reason, credit_note_number, note, created_by) VALUES (#{productId}, #{batchId}, #{movementType, typeHandler=cz.palo.autoservis.config.mybatis.PgEnumTypeHandler$MovementTypeHandler}, #{quantity}, #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{returnReason, typeHandler=cz.palo.autoservis.config.mybatis.PgEnumTypeHandler$ReturnReasonHandler}, #{creditNoteNumber}, #{note}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouse.stock_movements WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
